Name: Nyapu Style Eli and Dylan
Author: nugmods
Description:
[b]About this Mod:

[/b]As both a Nyapu enjoyer and NPC mod enthusiast, I like my portraits to match, so I made this Nyapu-style edit of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13883?tab=description]Eli & Dylan[/url]'s portraits for my own use. Nova and Nyapu were kind enough to give me permission to share, so for my fellow Nyapu enjoyers - here you go! Please go try out Nova's lovely mod and meet these two for yourself, I promise you won't be disappointed!

Edits are made using assets from the original mod, Nyapu, and some good old-fashioned hand-editing by me.

[b]How to Install:

[/b]If you use Nyapu's portraits, you should already know the deal, but as a reminder:

1. Download the zip
2. Unzip the files
3. Copy and paste the folder [CP] Nyapu-Style Eli and Dylan in your mods folder. That's literally it.

This is not a replacer. Do not attempt to use it as a replacer. Do not tell other people to use it as a replacer. You WILL fuck up your mods folder and I WILL delete your comment complaining about it, because I have no tolerance for people ignoring the instructions I spent time writing and then pretending they've never seen a Content Patcher mod before in their life. You had to install dozens of Content Patcher mods before you even made it to mine, including the og vanilla Nyapu mod, so come on now. You know what this is. Follow the instructions!!

[b]Disclaimers:
[/b]- Eli's hair is still unkempt at the Flower Dance. Sorry! I don't feel totally comfortable drawing that from scratch yet.
- Uses the original assets for Soot and the Spirit's Eve costumes (slightly tweaked). Because of that, the proportions might feel a little weird. Someday maybe I'll feel confident enough in my pixel art to do some fully scratch-made portraits, but today isn't that day!

[b]Credits:
[/b]Nyapu: for their amazing collection of portraits and the assets used to create these edits
Tenebrousnova: for the original Eli & Dylan mod! Seriously, I've had these boys for a week and I love them
NintheCactus: for Eli & Dylan's original portraits
